name: mirage
text: Understood. The history stars are gone and the rating now blends everything into one score. I kept the five book-evidence factors only because the data supports them, and added the type-of-bet, lead-time and small-book rules. On the 808 closed +EV bets so far, CLV rises with books agreeing, rises with edge up to about 4%, is best inside 6 hours (+1.9 to +3.1%) and fades beyond 24 hours (+0.2%). Props and NHL beat the close and moneylines, spreads and game totals don't. Prop overs beat the close but lose money in your history, so they get no CLV bonus. Two or fewer books with no sharp book now cap at 2 stars. The write-up with sources is research/star_rating_2026-10-23.md. The weights are modest because there are only about 10 days of closes, and I'll refit as more come in. Building the release now.
